questions.q: Which country ruled Hong Kong until 1997?
questions.why: It was handed back to China on 1 July 1997.

questions.q: Which war led to Britain taking Hong Kong Island in 1842?
questions.why: The Treaty of Nanking ceded it.

questions.q: Which country occupied Hong Kong during the Second World War?
questions.why: The occupation lasted from 1941 to 1945.

questions.q: Which 2014 protests were named after umbrellas?
questions.why: Protesters used umbrellas against pepper spray.

questions.q: Who was the last British Governor of Hong Kong?
questions.why: He left on the royal yacht Britannia.

questions.q: Which area was leased to Britain for 99 years in 1898?
questions.why: The lease ended in 1997.

questions.q: Who was Hong Kong's first Chief Executive?
questions.why: He took office in 1997.

questions.q: Which 1984 agreement set the terms for the 1997 handover?
questions.why: Margaret Thatcher and Zhao Ziyang signed it.

questions.q: Which mini-constitution has governed Hong Kong since 1997?
questions.why: It was passed by China's parliament in 1990.

questions.q: Which 2020 law changed Hong Kong's politics?
questions.why: It was passed by Beijing.

questions.q: Which walled city in Kowloon was demolished in 1993?
questions.why: It was one of the most crowded places on Earth.

questions.q: Which ferry has crossed Victoria Harbour since 1888?
questions.why: It is one of the world's cheapest scenic rides.

questions.q: Which theme park opened on Lantau in 2005?
questions.why: Ocean Park is another big park.

questions.q: Which bridge opened in 2018 links Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macau?
questions.why: It is about 55 km long.

questions.q: Which mainland city across the border grew from a fishing town?
questions.why: It became a special economic zone in 1980.

questions.q: Which harbour lies between Hong Kong Island and Kowloon?
questions.why: Its skyline light show is famous.

questions.q: Which famous peak gives views over Hong Kong?
questions.why: A tram climbs to it.

questions.q: Which giant bronze Buddha sits on Lantau Island?
questions.why: It is 34 m tall.

questions.q: Which famous outdoor escalator system runs up a hill in Central?
questions.why: It is the world's longest outdoor covered escalator.

questions.q: Which martial arts film star grew up in Hong Kong?
questions.why: He was born in San Francisco.

questions.q: Which horse-racing venue lies in the heart of Hong Kong Island?
questions.why: Wednesday night races are popular.

questions.q: Which rugby event is Hong Kong's biggest sporting party?
questions.why: It has been held since 1976.

questions.q: Which Hong Kong fencer won Olympic gold in 2021 and 2024?
questions.why: He won the men's foil twice.

questions.q: Which Hong Kong actor starred in 'Police Story' and 'Rush Hour'?
questions.why: He does his own stunts.

questions.q: Which director made 'In the Mood for Love'?
questions.why: It starred Tony Leung and Maggie Cheung.

questions.q: What principle governs Hong Kong's relationship with China?
questions.why: It was meant to last 50 years.

questions.q: What is Hong Kong's currency?
questions.why: It is pegged to the US dollar.

questions.q: Which small steamed dishes are eaten at yum cha?
questions.why: Har gow and siu mai are favourites.

questions.q: Which language is most widely spoken in Hong Kong?
questions.why: English is also an official language.

questions.q: Which sweet egg tart is a Hong Kong café favourite?
questions.why: Cha chaan teng cafés serve it.
